description: One-shot tool: kick off AI store generation, wait for it to complete (~30-60s), and return everything needed to launch — store URL, Stripe onboarding link, and structured JSON. Perfect for "create me a store for X" requests. After this returns, the user only needs to: 1) connect Stripe via the provided URL, 2) call publish_store.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key to prevent duplicate stores on retry

product_name.description: Name of the product (e.g. "Handmade Soy Candles")

vibe.description: Design vibe: minimal, luxury, bold, playful, or professional

name: create_full_store
